title: Poetry cannot install Numpy 2.2.1

labels.name: status/triage
labels.description: This issue needs to be triaged

body:
### Description

First reported here: https://github.com/numpy/numpy/issues/28126

Poetry cannot install the latest version of `numpy`, 2.2.1. I also experience this issue with Poetry 2.0.1.

### Workarounds

None that I found.

### Poetry Installation Method

install.python-poetry.org

Ubuntu 24.04
